violations.text: Avocados were observed thawing in stagnant water on the counter. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must be thawed in one of the following manners: under refrigeration (41 degrees Fahrenheit or less); completely submerged under running water; as part of the cooking process; or in the microwave if cooked immediately after thawing. Food items were moved into mechanical refrigeration during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the kitchen 3-bay sink and dishwasher. Establishment is to obtain test strips. New Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2025
